gloss: to cut down; to reduce; to devalue; to round down

definitions.gloss: to cut down; to reduce (prices, wages)
definitions.explanation: To lower or reduce something, especially in a financial context.
To officially lower the value of a currency.
In mathematics, to reduce a number to a lower whole value.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{経費|けいひ}を{切|き}り{下|さ}げた。
examples.english: The company cut down on expenses.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{通貨|つうか}を{切|き}り{下|さ}げる{決定|けってい}をした。
examples.english: The government decided to devalue the currency.

examples.japanese: {小数点|しょうすうてん}{以下|いか}を{切|き}り{下|さ}げて{計算|けいさん}する。
examples.english: Calculate by rounding down the decimal places.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
・Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
・Pattern: Xを{切|き}り{下|さ}げる

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {切|き}る (to cut) + {下|さ}げる (to lower)

CONJUGATION:
・{切|き}り{下|さ}げる → {切|き}り{下|さ}げない (negative)
・{切|き}り{下|さ}げる → {切|き}り{下|さ}げて (te-form)
・{切|き}り{下|さ}げる → {切|き}り{下|さ}げた (past)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{価格|かかく}を{切|き}り{下|さ}げる - to cut prices
・{賃金|ちんぎん}を{切|き}り{下|さ}げる - to reduce wages
・{通貨|つうか}を{切|き}り{下|さ}げる - to devalue currency
・{小数点|しょうすうてん}{以下|いか}を{切|き}り{下|さ}げる - to round down decimals

ANTONYM:
{切|き}り{上|あ}げる - to round up; to raise
